title: Appalachian Ridge-and-Valley: Berry Mountain, Mahantango Mountain, and Lykens Valley

features.name: Mahantango Mountain Ridge
features.desc: Northern sandstone rampart of the Appalachian fold belt; continuous resistant ridge.

features.name: Berry Mountain Ridge
features.desc: Southern sandstone rampart capped by Mississippian Pocono conglomerate; peaks to 1,614 ft AMSL.

features.name: Lykens Valley Floor
features.desc: Fertile agricultural valley eroded into softer Devonian Catskill red shales and siltstones.

features.name: Susquehanna River Water Gap
features.desc: Antecedent river gorge where the Susquehanna River cuts transversely through the folded Appalachian ridges.

features.name: Millersburg
features.desc: Historic borough at the Susquehanna Water Gap; eastern terminus of the historic Millersburg Ferry.

features.name: Elizabethville
features.desc: Major commercial and historic borough in southern Lykens Valley along US-209 near Berry Mountain.

features.name: Berrysburg
features.desc: Historic central Lykens Valley agricultural borough founded in 1819 on rolling Catskill shale uplands.

features.name: Gratz
features.desc: Historic borough along PA-25 founded in 1805; home of the historic Gratz Agricultural Fair.

features.name: Lykens
features.desc: Historic anthracite mining borough and namesake of Lykens Valley; gateway to Short Mountain and Bear Creek.

features.name: Williamstown
features.desc: Eastern valley borough in Williams Valley along Wiconisco Creek; historic anthracite colliery center.

features.name: Pillow (Uniontown)
features.desc: Historic borough incorporated in 1864 at the Mahantango Creek gap north of Mahantango Mountain.

features.name: Wiconisco
features.desc: Historic mining community nestled between Short Mountain and Bear Mountain east of Lykens.

features.name: Dalmatia
features.desc: Historic riverfront community (Georgetown) on the Susquehanna River north of Mahantango Mountain.

features.name: Klingerstown
features.desc: Gap community along Mahantango Creek between Mahantango Mountain and Line Mountain.

features.name: Spring Glen
features.desc: Agricultural valley community in Hubley Township along PA-25 between Gratz and Sacramento.

features.name: Sacramento
features.desc: Eastern valley community below the north flank of Mahantango Ridge opening into Hegins Valley.

features.name: Loyalton
features.desc: Valley settlement along Wiconisco Creek and US-209 between Elizabethville and Lykens.

features.name: Killinger
features.desc: Western Lykens Valley crossroads community between Millersburg and Berrysburg.

features.name: Lenkerville
features.desc: Riverfront settlement along the Susquehanna River immediately south of Millersburg.

features.name: Hebe
features.desc: Upland agricultural village in Upper Mahanoy Township north of Mahantango Mountain.

features.name: Hickory Corners
features.desc: Farming community in the northern valley corridor near Dalmatia.

border_corridors.name: Halifax
border_corridors.desc: Historic Susquehanna borough south across Berry and Peters Mountains toward Harrisburg.

border_corridors.name: Herndon
border_corridors.desc: River borough in Northumberland County north of Dalmatia along the Susquehanna.

border_corridors.name: Valley View & Hegins
border_corridors.desc: Hegins Valley agricultural and residential communities in western Schuylkill County.

border_corridors.name: Tower City
border_corridors.desc: Borough in Williams Valley east of Williamstown connecting into the Southern Anthracite Coal Field.
